Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
Fixed Confirm being withheld for correctly prepared listings: game item names contain colour/edge formatting payloads and must be decoded as SeString before comparison. This also fixes AutoTidy relisting and AutoRefresh editor checks.
Listing prompts and diagnostics use decoded text. Exact item, price, quantity and same-retainer checks remain; unrelated prompts and malformed text stay blocked.
All 187 automated checks pass; release build has zero warnings/errors. Released for in-game testing; native confirmation smoke tests remain pending.
